title: Short Shift
summary: The Scrag Warren's goblins have dug through into the Cold Seam's old workings. Dagny's niece Tamsin went down after the Seam's records and didn't come up.

steps.journal: Go down the Cold Seam, off the Wickham road south of Ashgate, through the old pithead to the goblins' warren. Their foreman keeps the tally cave.

ready: The Foreman is down and his whistle is quiet. Go back to Dagny Coalbrook at the Slag & Bellows in Ashgate.
done: The Foreman is down and the tally cave is quiet. Dagny bought the moot a round, which the moot says has never happened.
